function.name: run_sql
function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT vb.vendor_invoice_no, COUNT(*) AS invoice_cnt FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor_bill vb WHERE vb.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09') GROUP BY vb.vendor_invoice_no HAVING COUNT(*) \u003e 1","purpose":"Find duplicate vendor invoice numbers in vendor_bill for Aug/Sep 2026"}
